name: Sweet & Sour Meatballs
description: A hearty meatball dish smothered in a rich sweet and sour pineapple sauce, baked to perfection.
recipeIngredient: For the sauce: ½ cup brown sugar, ½ cup vinegar, 19 oz pineapple tidbits (undrained), ½ tsp salt, 1 Tbsp cornstarch

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together ground beef, onion, cracker crumbs, garlic, pepper, egg, and milk. Chill until firm.
Shape into evenly sized meatballs and place on a greased broiler pan.
Broil to brown on all sides, watching carefully.
Place meatballs in a casserole dish.
To make the sauce, combine brown sugar, salt, and cornstarch. Gradually stir in vinegar and soya sauce. Add pineapple tidbits and bring to a boil until thickened and clear.
Pour the sauce over the meatballs and bake in the oven at 350°F for 1 hour.

keywords: sweet and sour meatballs, baked meatballs, pineapple sauce

_similar.name: Hawaiian Meatballs
_similar.description: A Hawaiian-inspired meatball recipe with a sweet and sour sauce, cooked in a pan and finished in the oven.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the meat mixture together and shape into balls.
Dredge the meatballs in flour and brown in shortening on both sides.
Remove the meatballs from the pan and set aside.
Mix the dry sauce ingredients well, then stir in the wet ingredients.
Stir the sauce mixture into the fat in the pan and cook until thick and bubbly.
Return the meatballs to the pan, cover, and put in the oven to cook for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: Hawaiian meatballs, sweet and sour sauce, oven-finished

_similar.name: Meat Balls and Sour And Sweet Sauce
_similar.description: A classic meatball recipe served in a tangy sweet and sour sauce, perfect for serving over meatballs, chicken, or pork chops.
recipeIngredient: 1 tsp onion flakes or 1 tsp real onion

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together and form into 1½ inch balls.
Bake in an ungreased oblong pan for 20 to 25 minutes at 400°F.
Remove from oven and drain grease.
Place meatballs in a large casserole.
Pour sweet and sour sauce over the top and return to oven for 10 minutes or until hot.
To make the sauce, mix all ingredients together in a saucepan and stir while bringing to a boil until thickened.

_similar.keywords: meatballs, sweet and sour sauce, baked meatballs

_similar.name: Sweet & Sour Pineapple Chicken
_similar.description: A sweet and tangy chicken dish baked in a pineapple-based sauce, perfect for a comforting meal.
recipeIngredient: ⅗ cup (¼ cup + 2 Tbsp) crushed pineapple, drained

recipeInstructions.text: Simmer the chicken breasts in water until cooked through, turning occasionally.
In a pan, combine crushed pineapple, vinegar, brown sugar, salt, ketchup, and water. Cook over heat, stirring until the sauce thickens.
Place the cooked chicken in a casserole dish and pour the sweet and sour sauce over the top.
Cover the dish with tinfoil and bake at 325°F for 1½ hours.

_similar.keywords: sweet and sour chicken, pineapple chicken, baked chicken

_similar.name: Cheeseburger Meat Loaf
_similar.description: A cheeseburger-inspired meatloaf with a cheddar cheese and pickle relish filling, topped with tomato sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: In a mixing bowl, combine ground beef, egg, bread crumbs, garlic salt, onion powder, salt, pepper, and seasoning salt. Mix well.
Mix chopped onion and tomato sauce together in a separate bowl.
Add half of the tomato sauce and onion mixture to the beef mixture and mix well.
Pack half of the beef mixture into a loaf pan.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese and sweet pickle relish evenly over the top.
Pack the remaining beef mixture on top and press firmly.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350°F for 1 hour.
Carefully spoon off excess fat from the top.
Pour the remaining tomato sauce and onion mixture over the meatloaf.
Bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Let stand for about 5 minutes before inverting onto a heated serving platter if desired.

_similar.keywords: cheeseburger meatloaf, stuffed meatloaf, cheddar and pickle filling
